subject: App Crash Report - opening settings
body:
Hi Team,
Every time I open Settings the app crashes to home screen. Device: Samsung Galaxy S21, OS: Android 13. Steps: 1) Open app 2) Tap Profile 3) Tap Settings -> crash.

subject: Login Issue - invalid token
body: Can't login since the latest update. It shows 'invalid token'. I tried clearing cache. Device: iPhone 12, iOS 17.0.2. Please advise.

subject: Feature Request: Dark Mode
body: Would love a dark mode option for night use. Many users have requested this on forums. Thanks.

subject: Data Loss Problem - notes missing after sync
body: After syncing between phone and tablet some notes disappeared. Device: Pixel 6, Android 12. Repro steps: sync on phone -> open tablet -> missing entries.

subject: Suggestion for Improvement - export CSV
body: Please add ability to export CSV directly from mobile. That would help our team workflows.

subject: App is slow on older devices
body: App lags on my Xiaomi Redmi 7. Scrolling is janky and images take time to load. OS: Android 9.

subject: Unable to restore purchases
body: I reinstalled and can't restore my premium purchases. Order ID: ORD-55823. Device: OnePlus 8, Android 11.

subject: Praise: Excellent performance
body: After the update the app feels snappier — great work!

subject: Login: 'network error' after reinstall
body: I can't login after reinstalling. Keeps saying 'network error' though my internet is fine. Device: iPhone SE (2020), iOS 15.

subject: Crash when uploading photo
body: App crashes whenever I try to upload a photo to a report. Device: Samsung A12, Android 11. Repro: Create report -> Add photo -> crash.

subject: Complaint: Poor customer service
body: I emailed support 2 weeks ago and haven't received a response about billing.

subject: Feature Request: Calendar integration
body: It would be great if reminders could sync with Google Calendar or iOS Calendar.

subject: Too expensive - subscription feedback
body: The subscription price is too steep for casual users. Consider a basic tier.
